narrative: Material PL1__M3883975 exhibits intermittent demand (53.8% non-zero days) with a high CV of 1.36, indicating highly variable burst consumption patterns. Lead times are unstable (CV=0.94, mean=1.74 days), which jointly with demand variability drives a required safety stock of 501 units — nearly 3x the current SAP level of 171. The EOQ of 1,674 units is 5.4x the current order quantity, collapsing annual orders from 102 to 19 and delivering 55% total cost savings. The (r,Q) continuous-review policy is selected as it best handles the stochastic demand and lead time combination while respecting the MOQ and storage constraints.
